nodes.description: Caller address, attacker-controllable; used for owner assignment, onlyOwner checks, tokenFallback gating and bet target.
Contract owner address; guards privileged functions through onlyOwner.
Emergency pause flag checked by gameIsActive modifier.
Bankroll address; receives ETH in dumpdivs and is the approved token spender.
Expected ZTH token contract address; compared with msg.sender in tokenFallback.
External ZTH token interface used for transfer/approve calls.
Tracked token balance used to compute maxProfit and payouts.
House edge numerator used in calculateProfit.
Maximum allowed profit per bet; recomputed in setMaxProfit.
Owner-configurable percentage scaling maxProfit.
Minimum accepted bet size enforced by betIsValid.
Counter of placed bets, incremented in _playerRollDice.
Cumulative tokens wagered, incremented in _playerRollDice.
Mapping of pending player rolls; read, written and deleted around external transfers.
Deployment constructor: sets owner to msg.sender, configures token/bankroll interfaces and approves bankroll.
Payable fallback that accepts ETH dividends.
Public view randomness source built from blockhash of a caller-supplied block number.
Internal helper reducing maxRandom modulo upper.
Computes potential profit from bet size, roll and houseEdge.
Records a new bet, finishes any previous roll and updates counters.
Public entry point that settles the caller's own pending roll.
Settles a roll: computes result, adjusts contractBalance, deletes state and transfers payout.
ERC223 callback; restricted to the ZTH token and distinguishes bankroll deposits from player bets.
Internal recomputation of maxProfit from contractBalance.
Owner-only manual override of contractBalance.
Owner-only setter for maxProfitAsPercentOfHouse with a 20% cap.
Owner-only setter for minBet.
Owner-only token withdrawal that subtracts from contractBalance then transfers.
Owner-only toggle of the gamePaused flag.
Owner-only bankroll replacement and token approval management.
Owner-only transfer of contract ownership.
Owner-only emergency function transferring tokens then selfdestructing.
Unauthenticated public function forwarding contract ETH to the bankroll.
Private check that a token address equals ZTHTKNADDR.
Access control modifier comparing msg.sender to owner.
Modifier validating profit, minimum bet and roll range.
Modifier requiring gamePaused to be false.
Safe multiplication library function.
Safe subtraction library function used on contractBalance.
Safe addition library function used on contractBalance and wagering counters.
Outcome derived from blockhash(blockn) and caller-supplied entropy; predictable/manipulable randomness.
contractBalance.sub(profit) reduces tracked balance before payout transfer.
contractBalance.add(roll.tokenValue) increases tracked balance on a loss.
External token transfer of profit plus stake to the player inside _finishBet.
selfdestruct(owner) destroys the contract and forwards any residue.
External token transfer used by ownerTransferZTH and ownerkill.
Unguarded ZethrBankroll.transfer(address(this).balance) in dumpdivs.

Roll-under argument of _playerRollDice.
TKN struct argument of _playerRollDice.

Extra data (chosen number) argument of tokenFallback.
Token address argument of _zthToken.
playerRoll memory struct loaded from playerRolls in _playerRollDice and _finishBet.
Computed dice result inside _finishBet.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, linking an untrusted caller to the privileged owner slot.
msg.sender is read in the constructor as the initial owner and approves the bankroll.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender with owner to authorize privileged calls.
owner state variable is the reference checked inside the onlyOwner modifier.
ownerUpdateContractBalance is gated by onlyOwner.
ownerSetMaxProfitAsPercentOfHouse is gated by onlyOwner.
ownerSetMinBet is gated by onlyOwner.
ownerTransferZTH is gated by onlyOwner.
ownerPauseGame is gated by onlyOwner.
ownerSetBankroll is gated by onlyOwner.
ownerChangeOwner is gated by onlyOwner.
ownerkill is gated by onlyOwner.
tokenFallback requires msg.sender == ZTHTKNADDR, so the caller identity controls bet/deposit entry.
ZTHTKNADDR is the expected caller compared against msg.sender in tokenFallback.
tokenFallback routes player bets into _playerRollDice.
Bankroll deposits in tokenFallback trigger setMaxProfit.
contractBalance is increased by _value for bankroll deposits.
_playerRollDice settles any existing roll by calling _finishBet.
finishBet delegates settlement of msg.sender's roll to _finishBet.
_finishBet calls calculateProfit, an unchecked-expression profit computation path.
Profit computed by calculateProfit flows into the payout and balance arithmetic in _finishBet.
_finishBet updates maximum profit through setMaxProfit.
setMaxProfit writes the maxProfit state variable.
setMaxProfit derives maxProfit from contractBalance.
setMaxProfit scales by maxProfitAsPercentOfHouse.
_finishBet adds or subtracts the wager/profit from contractBalance, changing the payout basis mid-execution.
_finishBet reads the pending roll from the playerRolls mapping.
_finishBet deletes/overwrites playerRolls state while an external token transfer follows, enabling state-inconsistent re-entry.
The external token transfer callback can re-enter _finishBet (directly or via tokenFallback) before accounting settles.
Player target, profit and stake flow from _finishBet into the external ZTHTKN.transfer call.
random delegates to maxRandom.
maxRandom feeds blockhash/entropy into the weak randomness sink.
_finishBet requests the game outcome through random/maxRandom.
_playerRollDice validates the token contract via _zthToken.
_zthToken compares its argument with ZTHTKNADDR.
totalBets is incremented with unchecked '+=' inside _playerRollDice.
totalZTHWagered accumulates _tkn.value with unchecked '+='.
ZTHTKN interface is the external contract invoked for the payout transfer.
ownerTransferZTH performs an external token transfer through ZTHTKN.
ownerTransferZTH subtracts the withdrawn amount from contractBalance before the external transfer.
ownerkill executes selfdestruct(owner), an irreversible privileged operation.
ownerkill also drains tracked tokens via the external ZTHTKN.transfer before selfdestruct.
dumpdivs performs an unauthenticated external transfer of the whole ETH balance.
ZethrBankroll is the destination of the unguarded balance transfer in dumpdivs.
gameIsActive reads the gamePaused flag for its require.
_playerRollDice is executed only when the game is not paused.
finishBet is executed only when the game is not paused.
ownerPauseGame writes the gamePaused state variable.
ownerChangeOwner rewrites the owner state variable, transferring all privileges.
houseEdge participates in the profit arithmetic and its rounding behaviour.
minBet is a bound checked by the betIsValid modifier.
maxProfit bounds the acceptable profit in betIsValid.
_playerRollDice can only proceed when betIsValid holds.
ownerSetMaxProfitAsPercentOfHouse triggers setMaxProfit after updating the percentage.
ownerUpdateContractBalance overwrites the contractBalance used for payout sizing.
ownerSetBankroll issues token approvals through the ZTHTKN interface.
ZTHTKN approve calls depend on the current token interface instance.
_finishBet relies on SafeMath.sub for balance and bet arithmetic.
_finishBet relies on SafeMath.add when crediting losing bets.
tokenFallback uses SafeMath.add to credit bankroll deposits.
The external bankroll transfer in dumpdivs can call back into the contract while the balance is being forwarded.
The external token transfer invoked by ownerTransferZTH can re-enter contract entry points.
_finishBet performs contractBalance.sub(profit) on the winning path.
_finishBet performs contractBalance.add(roll.tokenValue) on the losing path.

normalization_plan.reason: Bet size parameter only exists to be range-checked by the betIsValid modifier, so it folds into that core node.
Roll-under parameter is only used for the min/max checks in betIsValid.
Token address parameter is consumed solely by the constructor to set ZTHTKN and ZTHTKNADDR.
Bankroll address parameter is consumed solely by the constructor configuration.
Block number parameter feeds directly into the blockhash randomness source of maxRandom.
Entropy parameter is hashed into the maxRandom output.
Upper bound parameter only serves the modulo reduction in random.
Initial bet parameter has no identity beyond the profit formula in calculateProfit.
Roll parameter is used only inside the calculateProfit arithmetic.
Roll-under parameter is stored into the playerRolls struct by _playerRollDice.
TKN struct parameter is the bet payload processed by _playerRollDice.
Flag parameter only controls the state deletion branch inside _finishBet.
Target address parameter selects which player roll _finishBet settles.
Parameter exists only as the assignment value for contractBalance in that setter.
Parameter only carries the capped percentage into maxProfitAsPercentOfHouse.
Parameter only carries the new lower bound into minBet.
Recipient parameter is used only as the transfer destination in ownerTransferZTH.
Amount parameter is used only for the balance subtraction and transfer in ownerTransferZTH.
Parameter only carries the new gamePaused boolean.
Parameter only carries the replacement bankroll address.
Parameter only carries the replacement owner address.
Token sender parameter is used solely for bankroll detection and bet attribution in tokenFallback.
Value parameter is used solely to build the TKN struct or credit contractBalance in tokenFallback.
Data parameter is decoded only for the chosen roll number in tokenFallback.
Token address parameter is only compared with ZTHTKNADDR inside _zthToken.
The playerRoll memory copy exists to read, update and persist playerRolls in _playerRollDice (and the equivalent copy in _finishBet), so it folds into that core function.
Local result value only exists to compare against rollUnder in _finishBet.
Local profit value only exists to feed the balance subtraction and payout in _finishBet.
Cached roll-under value is only used within _finishBet.
Decoded number only exists to build the bet passed from tokenFallback.
The TKN memory struct only exists to forward the bet from tokenFallback into _playerRollDice.
